plugins.name: JS Handler
plugins.description: A CLIProxyAPI plugin that executes external JavaScript scripts to intercept and modify requests, responses, and streaming chunks using the Goja VM engine.
plugins.author: easyatm

plugins.name: Codex Invite
plugins.description: Sends Codex referral invite emails from CPA using a selected Codex OAuth credential.
plugins.author: Supra4E8C

plugins.name: Codex Quota Scheduler
plugins.description: Optimizes Codex account scheduling in CPA with quota-aware Fill First ordering, reset probing, and a Management-key-gated bilingual UI.
plugins.author: Jeffery

plugins.name: CPA Usage Keeper
plugins.description: Adds a CPAMC entry for opening CPA Usage Keeper from the management center. Requires CPA Usage Keeper v1.12.2 or later.
plugins.author: Willxup

plugins.name: Privacy Filter
plugins.description: Intercepts model requests and redacts emails, phone numbers, API keys, tokens, and other secrets before they reach upstream providers, using embedded Gitleaks rules.
plugins.author: rheodev

plugins.name: Antigravity Coding Filter
plugins.description: Intercept requests from mainstream programming software, especially reverse-engineering-related requests from Google Antigravity, to prevent account bans.
plugins.author: jellyfish-p

plugins.name: Gemini CLI
plugins.description: A plugin that adds Gemini CLI upstream provider support to CLIProxyAPI through the native plugin ABI.
plugins.author: Luis Pater

plugins.name: Priority Auto Router
plugins.description: Routes Claude Code and Codex CLI model alias requests through prioritized CPA provider candidates with automatic fallback.
plugins.author: Amin

plugins.name: Codex 429 Auto Ban
plugins.description: Auto-disables Codex credentials on 429 and auto re-enables them after the exhausted rate-limit window (5-hour or weekly) refreshes, using upstream x-codex-* response headers.
plugins.author: ysxk

plugins.name: Model Fallback Router
plugins.description: Retries matching model requests through configured fallback model names when the primary model fails with quota, rate-limit, transport, or configured HTTP status errors.
plugins.author: thebtf

plugins.name: CPA Key Policy
plugins.description: Manages plugin-owned downstream API keys with per-key model alias lists routed to CPA provider models, per-key RPM, daily/weekly USD usage limits with cache-aware billing (cache spend + hit-rate reporting), and management APIs. Includes an embedded multilingual (zh-CN/zh-TW/en/ru) Key Policy UI served as a CPA plugin resource, following the panel's language. Acts as a non-exclusive frontend auth provider (native api-keys may still be used).
plugins.author: origin652

plugins.name: CPA Session Archive
plugins.description: Archives CPA requests as deduplicated sessions and agent turns, with a multilingual management UI for faceted browsing, diagnostics, and streaming training-data exports.
plugins.author: linonetwo

plugins.name: Embeddings Rerank Forward
plugins.description: Forwards OpenAI-compatible embeddings and Cohere-style rerank requests to upstream providers. Supports multiple providers per route with model aliasing and key failover.
plugins.author: KorenKrita

plugins.name: CPA Token Usage
plugins.description: Codex account usage, quota tracking, 429 autoban and provider cost dashboard.
plugins.author: zhumengling

plugins.name: Model Mapper
plugins.description: Maps requested CLIProxyAPI model names to upstream models across Claude, OpenAI Chat Completions, and OpenAI Responses.
plugins.author: DoingDog

plugins.name: CodexCont
plugins.description: Continues gpt-5.5 folded reasoning streams inside CLIProxyAPI when upstream truncation matches the CodexCont heuristic.
plugins.author: cwzsquare

plugins.name: CodexComp
plugins.description: Targets gpt-5.5 streamed-request reasoning truncation and folds continuation rounds when encrypted reasoning content is available.
plugins.author: uf-hy

plugins.name: Grok Panel
plugins.description: Provides a Chinese Grok account dashboard for usage statistics, Free/Super/Heavy subscription classification, health checks, protected-account rules, and safe credential cleanup.
plugins.author: TizenryA

plugins.name: Usage Statistics
plugins.description: Persists per-request usage (tokens, latency, TTFT, reasoning effort, service tier, and failures) to a local SQLite database, and exposes management-key-gated query and delete APIs.
plugins.author: Fwindy

plugins.name: CAP Token Usage Tracker
plugins.description: Persistent token usage tracking with hourly aggregation, multi-dimensional statistics (model, provider, executor, alias, origin, auth type, service tier, reasoning effort, failure), and an embedded Chinese dashboard in Management Center.
plugins.author: AITNR

plugins.name: Grok Inspection
plugins.description: Background xAI/Grok account inspection for CPA, with permission, quota, login, and health classification; supports full/incremental/classify-scoped re-inspect and bulk actions.
plugins.author: ywddd

plugins.name: OpenCode Go Pool
plugins.description: Quota-aware cross-protocol account pooling and failover for OpenCode Go subscriptions.
plugins.author: hrz6976

plugins.name: CPA Account Config Manager
plugins.description: Manages CLIProxyAPI account configurations with redacted account inspection, multi-format import and export, usage visibility, safe batch edits, persistent defaults, and in-plugin account CRUD.
plugins.author: Mxucc

plugins.name: Quota Router
plugins.description: Routes protected Claude model requests away from OAuth accounts that reach a configurable seven-day usage cutoff, with request-triggered quota refreshes and authenticated status reporting.
plugins.author: Smarty Pants Inc

plugins.name: Codex Agent Identity
plugins.description: Adds CPA-native support for Codex Agent Identity JWT and Personal Access Token credentials with encrypted sidecar storage, preview-first batch import, safe auth-file synchronization, and a Management-key-protected plugin route.
plugins.author: simplez2

plugins.name: Quota Activation
plugins.description: Manual and automatic quota reset activation for Codex and Antigravity credentials.
plugins.author: Cody292

plugins.name: CPA Quota API Extension
plugins.description: Exports sanitized, provider-neutral quota data for the CLIProxyAPI credential pool through authenticated Management API endpoints for dashboards and monitoring automation.
plugins.author: dinhkarate

plugins.name: Anti Model Fallback
plugins.description: Blocks upstream model fallback: detects when a different model served the request, retries until the processing model matches the requested one, and returns an error once the retry budget is exhausted.
plugins.author: lkangd

plugins.name: OpenCode Cloak
plugins.description: Rewrites opencode CLI requests to carry a Claude Code billing header and fingerprint while preserving opencode's own system prompt, so a Claude OAuth subscription proxied through CPA is not flagged as third-party traffic.
plugins.author: conversun

plugins.name: Apply Patch Bridge
plugins.description: Bridges the Codex client's native apply_patch tool to backends without freeform custom-tool support (Claude, etc.): rewrites custom tools into {"input": string} function tools on the request path and restores custom_tool_call events on the response path, so structured patch edits, diff review cards, and one-click undo work for every model behind the proxy. | 让 Codex 客户端在 Claude 等不支持 freeform custom 工具的后端上恢复原生 apply_patch:请求方向把 custom 工具改写为 {"input": string} 函数工具,响应方向还原 custom_tool_call 事件族,结构化补丁编辑、差异审核卡与一键撤销对代理后的所有模型可用。
plugins.author: zhangziming1124

plugins.name: Credential Priority
plugins.description: Automatically sorts Antigravity, Codex, and xAI credentials by fresh quota evidence.
plugins.author: Cody292

plugins.name: Codex PAT
plugins.description: Validates and imports Codex Personal Access Tokens as CPA-compatible credentials, with a Management-key-protected bilingual UI.
plugins.author: Ca11back

plugins.name: GitHub Copilot Provider
plugins.description: Adds GitHub Copilot subscription models to CLIProxyAPI through GitHub device-code OAuth, dynamic model discovery, and Claude Messages translation.
plugins.author: Arthur Sommer

plugins.name: Sub2API Balance
plugins.description: Tracks balances, quotas, usage, billing multipliers, and peak billing windows for selected Sub2API-backed CPA providers in a management dashboard.
plugins.author: wi1shu

plugins.name: Grok Egress Guard
plugins.description: CPA-native Grok/xAI egress node management with sticky proxy binding, passive and active quality probes, quarantine migration, and a management dashboard for degraded-output recovery.
plugins.author: lij768423-svg

plugins.name: Codex Auto Reset
plugins.description: Automatically redeems soonest-expiring Codex Reset Bank credits before they expire, with idempotent retry, triple verification, and a bilingual management UI with reset statistics.
plugins.author: Jeffery

plugins.name: Key Model Access
plugins.description: Provides exclusive downstream API key authentication with per-key model allow and deny policies, plus a Management-key-protected settings UI.
plugins.author: Supra4E8C

plugins.name: DeepSeek Vision
plugins.description: Adds reliable image understanding to text-only DeepSeek models by analyzing request images with a host-configured vision model and transparently replacing them with visual context.
plugins.author: Zesuy

plugins.name: Codex Local Compact
plugins.description: Emulates Codex Responses Remote Compaction V2 for configured DeepSeek and OpenAI-compatible models through CPA's host model API.
plugins.author: JHXSMatthew

plugins.name: Prompt Rules
plugins.description: Injects or strips system and user prompt text before provider translation, with model and protocol scoping.
plugins.author: markhuangai

plugins.name: Model Router
plugins.description: Adds logical model aliases with priority or round-robin selection, cooldowns, and failover across CPA model targets.
plugins.author: markhuangai
